meta.notesConvention: FertilizerRecommendation has no notes column (batches 1-4 pattern). Caveats mapped to: soilContext (K-conditionality), micronutrients (S/B/Zn), applicationMethod (inoculation, trial-status), Source.notes (oxide-form caveat).
meta.regionMapping: Research JSON used 'in-pb' — reused existing 'in-punjab' (same region, established by batch 1). 'in' (national) → regionSlug null for recommendations; new 'in-national' region for windows only (bd-national precedent). meta.scope: India only — 22 records (confidence high/medium-high/medium). 6 India records refused (trial-only, below the batches 1-4 bar): M-IN-4, M-IN-8, S-IN-3, S-IN-4, L-IN-5, L-IN-6. 5 Pakistan records HELD (M-PK-1, C-PK-1, S-PK-1, S-PK-2, L-PK-1) — genuine source conflicts/gaps, NOT populated.
